subject.title: Core hardening tracker: converge duplicated runtime invariants onto single owners

question: Which source-verified remaining seams should be sponsored and sequenced next under this core-hardening tracker?
rationale: Source inspection confirms remaining duplication, but the rows cross permanent agent, gateway, session, plugin, and provider ownership boundaries; automation cannot safely choose priority or permanent API ownership.

options.title: Sequence runtime drift first
options.body: Keep the tracker and sponsor the most behavior-sensitive copied-policy and authority seams as separate focused PRs.

options.title: Narrow the umbrella
options.body: Retain behavior-affecting rows here and move lower-priority type-shape or metadata cleanup to independent follow-ups.

options.title: Require standalone sponsorship
options.body: End the umbrella and require a new maintainer-sponsored issue before any remaining seam proceeds.

recommendation.title: Sequence runtime drift first
recommendation.body: Keep the tracker and sponsor the most behavior-sensitive copied-policy and authority seams as separate focused PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: The representative current-main paths connect to his recent history, and this cross-boundary sequencing choice requires repository-level architecture direction.
